title: CINDER PTV input contract (ptv.2.1-indexed-v1-noarcs)
description: The Patient Trajectory Vector (PTV) input contract consumed by `cinder.bayes`. PTVs are produced by the 2OPMD ingest step that consumes FORWARD WebQuest semi-annual wave exports (and EHR when available). The contract pins the small core that the vendored Bayesian kernel layer actually reads (events, annotations.salience, annotations.status_flags, annotations.value, timestamps), and is permissive on the index sidecars (`metadata.index`, `metadata.entities`, `metadata.code_index`) since those are tooling outputs that legitimately grow over time. The required `metadata.pii_scrubbed` block is what couples to scripts/pii_tripwire.py.

events.description: Event records keyed by event_id. Each value must conform to #/$defs/event.

patient_id.description: Random UUID minted by 2OPMD. Per scrub policy, retained as an identifier with no link-back to identity without 2OPMD's internal mapping table.

built_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of PTV emission. Optional but strongly preferred for audit chains.

session_only.description: Conversation-mode flag: when true, this PTV is ephemeral and was constructed for a single chatbot session rather than a persisted analytic run.

$schema_ref.description: Optional self-tag used by scripts/validate_schemas.py to dispatch validation. Set to `ptv_input.schema.json` for explicit dispatch; absent in legacy/historical PTVs.

event_id.description: Stable identifier referenced from index sidecars and connascence relations.

event_type.description: Categorical event kind. The 12 values observed in the 2026-04-23 noarcs reference PTV. Schema is `enum`-typed for guidance but is intentionally extensible — when FORWARD-derived events introduce new types, add them here in lockstep with the ingest pipeline.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when known; the literal string `unknown` when the source did not date the event; or a `[*_REDACTED]` token when the original timestamp was identifying PII (e.g. a date-of-birth-derived event timestamp). Real-EHR PTVs commonly carry `unknown` and may carry redaction tokens after scrub. FORWARD-derived PRO events should always carry a wave-anchored ISO date.

preview.description: Free-text label, typically `<title> [<code>]` for diagnoses or `<drug> <dose>` for medications. Read by `bayes.py::_apply_match` for `preview_contains` rule matching.

status.description: Inclusion verdict from the upstream ingest pass. `included` = consume; `excluded` = drop from analyses; `deferred` = needs review; `suppressed` = M9 reflex-suppression outcome (event retained for audit but not advanced).

connascence.description: Co-occurrence relationships keyed by relation kind (`same_chapter`, `same_drug`, etc). Values are arrays of peer event_ids.

discovered_by.description: Provenance tags identifying the extractor / route that produced this record (e.g. `pdf_page_3`, `forward_wave_2024H2`, `regex_icd_code`).

annotations.description: Type-discriminated annotation block. The `card` and `salience` fields are required (cards anchor display, salience is read by the Bayesian likelihood weighter). The remaining fields are conditional on event_type and additionalProperties is open.

card.description: Compact display + audit summary read by chatbot, PDF renderers, and `bayes.py::_event_salience` (mirror).

type.description: Mirror of the event's `event_type` for self-contained card rendering.

salience.description: Importance score on the 0..10 scale used by `bayes.py::_event_salience` to weight evidence. Values < 0 are invalid; values > 10 are clipped during weighting per strategy doc §3.

status_flags.description: Status tags read by `bayes.py::_apply_match` for `status_flag_in` rule matching. Examples: `acute`, `chronic`, `worsening`, `improving`, `flare_signal`, `low_disease_activity`, `remission`.

value.description: Numeric measurement value when applicable (lab results, PRO scores, vital signs). `bayes.py::_apply_match` reads this for `value_above` / `value_below` thresholds.

chapter_kind.description: Categorization of the chapter this event belongs to. Values are tooling-defined and grow over time; the schema does not pin an enum. Observed in the EHR reference fixture: `summary`, `encounter`, `cover`.

entity_keys.description: Canonical entity refs of form `<kind>:<id>` matching keys in `metadata.entities` (e.g. `icd:i10`, `drug:methotrexate`, `drug:hydrocodone-acetaminophen`, `lab:hgb`). Drug names commonly contain hyphens, periods, and parentheses, so the pattern accepts the full set of lowercase identifier characters.

canonical_id.description: Stable hash anchor for cross-PTV deduplication.

heuristic_source.description: Identifier of the extractor heuristic that produced this annotation (`regex_icd_code`, `forward_pro_wave_v1`, `med_table_extractor`, etc).

edge_provenance.description: Per-edge provenance entries (preserved on noarcs variants for audit even though traversal arcs are not materialized).

cinder_pro.description: CINDER-specific PRO wave annotation. Required on every event whose `event_type` is `pro` or `pro_wave`. Fields below carry the §4.4 detection inputs that the `cinder_likelihood_spec.yaml` rules match against. Absent on legacy / EHR-only events that predate the FORWARD ingest (this is the design — schema is forward-compatible, not retroactive).

instrument.description: PRO instrument per protocol §4.4. Sub-domains (RAPID3_FN / RAPID3_PN / RAPID3_PtGA) are recorded for audit but, per §4.4 RAPID3 overlap clarification, are NOT counted as independent stack-level domains; only the composite RAPID3 score participates in stack counting.

delta_from_baseline.description: Δ vs M2-established chronic baseline. Populated by the M2 module after baseline establishment; null until then.

exceeds_band.description: Whether Δ exceeds the patient-specific M3 Stability Band. Populated by M3 after terrain indexing; null until then.

pii_scrubbed.description: Mandatory provenance block proving the scrubbing pipeline ran. `scripts/pii_tripwire.py` reads this to gate commits.

scrubber.description: Path / identity of the scrubber that ran (e.g. `server/scripts/scrub_real_ptv.py`).

audit_file.description: Relative path to the leftover-token audit transcript.

pro.description: PRO provenance. `source` distinguishes 2OPMD-internal PROs from FORWARD-derived; `forward` is the WebQuest landing zone (shape currently minimal; will expand once Adam Cornish confirms wave format).

forward.description: FORWARD WebQuest provenance block. Pre-call shape: `{patient_reported_outcomes_channel: bool}`. Will expand post-2026-05-26 to carry wave_export_id, wave_count, wave_date_range, instruments_present, etc.

patient.description: Patient demographics block. Minimal in the EHR reference fixture (`{dob: [DOB_REDACTED]}`); will expand for FORWARD-derived PTVs to include sex, race, ethnicity, BMI, smoking_status, ra_disease_duration, ra_seropositivity per `data_request/forward_field_spec.md`.

index.description: Derived sidecar indexes. Tooling output (chatbot retrieval, PDF rendering, MKG join). Permissive: ingest pipelines may add new index lanes.

code_index.description: Code-keyed event lookup tables. Standard buckets are `drugs`, `rxnorm`, `icd`, `labs`, `loinc`. Read by `bayes.py::_event_in_code_bucket` for code-aware likelihood rules.

last_pdf_ingest.description: Present when the PTV was constructed from a PDF source (the EHR reference fixture). Absent when the PTV was constructed purely from FORWARD WebQuest waves.
